Name: Ellestarglow Greenhouse
Author: ellestarglow
Description:
[size=6]Description[/size][size=3]
This mod replaces the greenhouse map with a much larger layout. The initial map is kept mostly the same: there is a new warp point near the water source that leads to the custom maps. This lets you use the mod in saves with the greenhouse already unlocked, and bypasses the issue with the warp point back to the farm that most greenhouse mods run into.


[/size][size=6]Features[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=4]The new layout includes 5 rooms.[/size][size=3]
 - The main room connects to the other new rooms and back to the original greenhouse map.
﻿-- 20 plots with 12 tiles each for 240 trellis crops
﻿-- A new water source designed to look similar to the fountain in Caroline's sunroom

 - The path on the left-hand side leads to the open plot.
﻿-- The size is 35 x 20 dirt tiles and can fit either 28 iridium sprinklers or 84 quality sprinklers
﻿-- NOTE: The plot isn't optimized for quality sprinklers.

 - The path on the right-hand side leads to a room for 32 fruit trees.

 - The stairways leading down on either side of the entrance lead to two additional basement cellars.
-- [size=3]The dimensions are 34 x 26 and each cellar can house over 500 crafting units, chests, etc.[/size]﻿
﻿-- A path connects the two cellars for ease of access
﻿-- Both rooms can use casks
[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=6]Changelog[/size][size=3]
 - Version 1.0.2:  Fixed a bug where fruit trees weren't allowed to be planted.
 - Version 1.0.1:  Fixed issue with walking outside of walls in new rooms.
 - Version 1.0.0:  Created mod.


[/size][size=6]How to Install[/size][size=3]
﻿1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
﻿2. Install the latest version of [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/ContentPatcher#install]Content Patcher[/url].
﻿3. Download this mod and unzip it into StardewValley/Mods.
﻿4. Run the game using SMAPI.


[/size][size=6]Compatibility[/size][size=3]
 - Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
 - Works in Single Player.
 - NOTE: Not tested in multiplayer or split-screen.

Feel free to let me know of any issues!


[/size][size=6]Acknowledgements[/size][size=3]
 - The Stardew Valley Wiki for teaching me everything I needed to know.
 - PathosChild for SMAPI and Content Patcher.  The docs really helped with the fine details.
 - All of your feedback!  Thanks for the encouragement, especially since this is my first mod.  Any suggestions, bug reports, etc. are welcome!

[/size]
